title: Model Binding & Validation
description: Understand how ASP.NET Core maps HTTP data to C# models, and how to enforce validation rules using Data Annotations, custom attributes, and client-side scripts.
longDescription: This module covers two of the most important features in ASP.NET Core MVC: `model binding` and `validation`. Model binding automatically converts incoming HTTP data (form fields, query strings, route values) into C# objects, so your action methods receive clean, typed parameters instead of raw strings. You will learn how binding works for simple types, complex objects, collections, and custom sources. The module then moves to validation — first using built-in `Data Annotation` attributes like `[Required]`, `[Range]`, and `[RegularExpression]`, then building custom validation attributes, and finally enabling unobtrusive client-side validation with jQuery. By the end, you will be able to protect your application from bad data at every layer.
whatYouLearn: Understand how ASP.NET Core `model binding` maps HTTP data to C# objects
Bind simple types, complex objects, collections, and arrays from form data and query strings
Use `[Bind]`, `[BindNever]`, and `[Bind(Prefix)]` to whitelist or exclude properties
Validate models using `Data Annotation` attributes such as `[Required]`, `[Range]`, and `[RegularExpression]`
Check `ModelState.IsValid` in action methods and display errors in views
Create custom validation attributes by inheriting from `ValidationAttribute`
Enable unobtrusive client-side validation with jQuery Validation and jQuery Unobtrusive Validation
Build a complete validated form with server-side and client-side checks
